name: VAR Models / Granger Causality
when_to_use: Two or more time series that potentially influence each other; model them jointly and test whether past values of one help predict another.
notes: Models several time series that influence each other and tests whether one helps predict another. Applications: check whether media spend today explains sales in the following weeks.

expected_input.question: Does one time series help predict another, and in which direction?

plain_explanation.purpose: Analyzes several series together and tests whether the past of one helps predict another.
plain_explanation.when_to_use_plain: When you want to know whether one series drives another in time, without proving real causation.
plain_explanation.data_needed: Two or more series columns over the same period and frequency.
plain_explanation.example: See whether a change in ads precedes a change in sales.
